lines.en: In the shallow lava, I swing my tail forward.

lines.zh: 池子很小，我绕一圈就到底。
lines.en: The pool is small; one lap takes me to the bottom.
I crawl along the scalding stone surface.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，溅起一点火星。
lines.en: One flick of my tail throws up sparks.
I can swim in water and in lava alike.
I hop across two pieces of basalt.
The lava is thick, so I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我从池子这头挪到那头。
lines.en: I inch from one side of the pool to the other.

lines.zh: 我的身子小，缝里都钻得进。
lines.en: I am small enough to squeeze into any crack.
The bank is hot, and I climb onto it anyway.
I move a little quicker in water.
Ash falls into the pool, and I push it aside.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，我滑进另一汪岩浆。
lines.en: With one flick, I slide into another lava pool.
I search for food along the pool's edge.

lines.zh: 岩浆池边有个凹口，我钻进去
lines.en: A notch in the lava pool's rim; I slip in.

lines.zh: 我并着腿往前弹，溅起一点浆
lines.en: I kick with both legs and splash a little lava.
Don't rush me. Wagging my tail takes time.

lines.zh: 这片玄武岩滩真够大的。
lines.en: This basalt flat is really huge.

lines.zh: 熔岩浅处，我抬头就能吃。
lines.en: In the shallow lava, I look up and eat.

lines.zh: 腿还没长齐，我只能摆尾。
lines.en: My legs aren't ready; I can only wag my tail.
Rain hits the lava with a hiss.
My little legs are getting sore from paddling.

lines.zh: 岩浆边长大，我一步一晃。
lines.en: Raised by lava, I sway with each step.
There are tender shoots in the basalt cracks.
In shallow lava I swim at ease.
In the shallow lava I'm still small.

lines.zh: 在熔岩里一摆一摆地游。
lines.en: I wiggle along through the lava.

lines.zh: 装进熔岩桶，我就不会消失。
lines.en: In a lava bucket, I will not vanish.

lines.zh: 熔岩在这边，浅滩在那边。
lines.en: Lava on this side, shallows on that side.

lines.zh: 浅熔岩里，我摆着小尾巴。
lines.en: In the shallow lava I flick my little tail.

lines.zh: 浅熔岩里，我慢慢转着游。
lines.en: In the shallow lava I slowly turn and swim.

lines.zh: 谁把岩缝里的嫩芽踩了？
lines.en: Who trampled the sprout in the rock crack?

lines.zh: 我浮在岩浆上，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I float on the lava with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 池子里的泡，一个一个破。
lines.en: The bubbles in the pool break one by one.

lines.zh: 我等着有人往水里丢东西。
lines.en: I wait for someone to throw something into the water.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像块黑石。
lines.en: When I am still, I look like a lump of black stone.
The heat makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有大兽在吼。
lines.en: I hear a great beast roaring far away.

lines.zh: 我是它的孩子，它不认我。
lines.en: I am its child, and it does not know me.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进温热的灰。
lines.en: I bury myself in the warm ash.
My tail sways slowly, and ripples spread.

lines.zh: 池子太小，装不下我的好奇。
lines.en: The pool is too small for all my curiosity.
I am waiting for a crimson mosquito.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在岩浆里发亮。
lines.en: My skin glows inside the lava.
Today is good for soaking in lava.

lines.zh: 一团热气从熔岩上飘过。
lines.en: A wisp of heat drifts over the lava.
Where had I swum to? I forgot.

lines.zh: 泡在熔岩里发呆最舒服。
lines.en: Blankly soaking in lava is the best.

lines.zh: 有浅熔岩泡着，日子就够好。
lines.en: A shallow lava soak is enough for a good day.
I'll just lie by the shallow lava.

lines.zh: 熔岩在脚边冒泡，我不怕。
lines.en: Lava bubbles at my feet, and I do not mind.
Let my tail soak warm first.

lines.zh: 泡在熔岩里，脑袋空空的。
lines.en: Soaking in lava, head completely empty.

lines.zh: 熔岩里的温水，泡着正好。
lines.en: The warm water in the lava suits me.

lines.zh: 浅熔岩里，我这么小一只。
lines.en: In the shallow lava, I'm so small.

lines.zh: 我泡在浅熔岩里，暖洋洋。
lines.en: Soaking in shallow lava, warm and cozy.

lines.zh: 浅熔岩里，我摆尾就能游。
lines.en: In shallow lava I swim with a flick.
There's a smell of sulfur in the wind.
The lava bubbles look better than clouds.

lines.zh: 等我长大，就能驮人过岩浆。
lines.en: Grown up, I'll carry riders over lava.
You crouch at the pool's edge and block the light.

lines.zh: 你的桶里装的是岩浆吗？
lines.en: Is that lava in your bucket?
I look up at you; my neck is very short.
Are you going to catch me? I will slip away.

lines.zh: 你的脸在热气里变形了。
lines.en: Your face warps in the rising heat.
That bucket in your hand looks familiar.
Do not put your hand in; it burns.
You blink, and I blink back.
You do not smell of ash at all.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是想要点吃的。
lines.en: I stare at you because I want a snack.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有熔岩的焦味。
lines.en: Your boots smell of scorched lava.
Your boots smell of tender sprouts.
A bucket of lava. Will you carry me?

lines.zh: 我在浅岩浆池里，凉快得很。
lines.en: I'm in a shallow lava pool. Quite cosy.

lines.zh: 你是来捞我的，还是路过？
lines.en: Are you here to scoop me up, or just passing by?
What are you looking at? No sprout by my mouth.
One lava bucket holds me.

lines.zh: 人类，你桶里装的是熔岩吗？
lines.en: Human, is that lava in your bucket?

lines.zh: 你手空空的，别挡我的浅滩。
lines.en: Your hands are empty. Don't block my shallows.
You're too tall. Squat down a bit.

lines.zh: 浅熔岩里，我只有拇指大。
lines.en: In the shallow lava I am thumb-sized.
Could that bucket you wear fit me?
One hit takes half my life.

lines.zh: 我蜷起身子，尾巴护住头。
lines.en: I curl up and shield my head with my tail.
Do not kick me; I have only four health.

lines.zh: 我往池底钻，躲开第二下。
lines.en: I dive for the bottom and dodge the second blow.
My tail is knocked crooked.
This wound is not small for me.
I sink, and the splash covers me.
You hit far too hard.
I let out a very thin sound.
I look for the great beast, but it is gone.
It hurts. I'll remember it in the basalt cracks.
Even my smooth skin is pulled tight.
Ouch! Who stepped on my tail?
Only a bucket of lava can hold me.
When I grow up, I'll butt you back.

lines.zh: 我的腿还在吧，熔岩太烫。
lines.en: Are my legs still there? The lava is hot.
This little pain will soak away in lava.
In the shallow lava I swim quite steady.
Stay back. I can swim away myself.
I need to slip back into the basalt cracks.
Crimson mosquito larva? Give it here.

lines.zh: 那东西在水里扭，我看见了。
lines.en: That thing wriggles in the water; I see it.
Wave it, and I will swim toward you.
I have loved these since I was tiny.
Bring it closer; my mouth cannot reach.
If I eat it, I might change.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，嘴张得很大。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and open my mouth wide.
The worm in your palm is still moving.
I circle it but do not dare bite.
Do not put it away; I have not eaten yet.
This bit of lava gets me running.

lines.zh: 谁拿着嫩芽，谁就是朋友。
lines.en: Whoever holds the tender sprout is my friend.
Steady your hand. Don't shake the sprout loose.

lines.zh: 熔岩这么浅，我只闻一下。
lines.en: The lava is shallow; just one sniff.
I swim in the shallow lava.
Is there another sprout by the shallow lava?
You know what a little tadpole likes.
That leaf smells so sweet.

lines.zh: 熔岩里那点亮，我看见了。
lines.en: That glimmer in the lava; I see it.
One bucket of lava and I'll follow.

lines.zh: 你拎着熔岩桶，我就跟着。
lines.en: Hold the lava bucket, and I'll follow.
In shallow lava, I swim happily.
This tender sprout is really for me?

lines.zh: 浅熔岩边那株草，给我一口。
lines.en: Just one bite of that grass by the shallow lava.

lines.zh: 比玄武岩上的苔藓香多了。
lines.en: Much tastier than the moss on basalt.
One sway of the lava bucket and I want to jump.

lines.zh: 你踩进池子，水花溅我一脸。
lines.en: You step into the pool and splash my face.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的靴子，弹开了。
lines.en: I bump your boot and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我的头很硬，你的脚踝小心。
lines.en: My head is hard; mind your ankle.

lines.zh: 你把我拨到一边，我又游回来。
lines.en: You push me aside, and I swim back.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，都是湿的。
lines.en: We knock together, and both of us are wet.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进池子，我躲开。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the pool, and I dodge.
I swim past, close to your feet.

lines.zh: 桶壁很滑，我撞了好几下。
lines.en: The bucket wall is slick; I hit it twice.
You shift one step, and I yield half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你的手指。
lines.en: My tail brushes your fingers.
I was soaking in the shallow lava, not moving.

lines.zh: 绯红蚊子幼虫，才是我想要的。
lines.en: Crimson mosquito larvae. That's what I want.

lines.zh: 你撞得我在熔岩里翻了个身。
lines.en: You knocked me into a roll in the lava.
Ouch, my little tail.
A little bump doesn't count as a fight, right?
In the shallow lava, my legs haven't grown.
Careful with my new little horn!

lines.zh: 慢慢走，我尾巴还没摆开。
lines.en: Walk slower. My tail hasn't swung clear yet.
Stop shoving. The shallow lava is only so wide.
Lava this shallow feels cramped.

lines.zh: 另一只蝌蚪在池子那头。
lines.en: Another tadpole is on the far side of the pool.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块石头转。
lines.en: We circle the same stone.

lines.zh: 它比我大一点，尾巴更长。
lines.en: It is a little bigger, with a longer tail.
In the lava, we touch heads.

lines.zh: 池子太小，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: The pool is too small, so we crowd together.
Its skin is redder than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，谁都不动。
lines.en: We float side by side and neither of us moves.
We wait for the eggs in the pool to hatch.
It swims off, and I follow.

lines.zh: 以后这池子会有很多小蝌蚪。
lines.en: One day this pool will hold many tadpoles.
From now on we'll swim in the lava together.
In this lava pool, just us two.
The warmth by the lava is just right.
Two little tadpoles, now a pair.
Swim slower. The lava will splash.
Come with me. That rock crack is warm.

lines.zh: 我在岩缝里留了最嫩的芽。
lines.en: I saved the tenderest sprout in the rock crack.
Don't hide. Watch me wag my tail.

lines.zh: 装进熔岩桶我就不会消失。
lines.en: In a lava bucket I won't fade.

lines.zh: 熔岩池还暖，再陪我一会儿。
lines.en: The lava pool is still warm. Stay a little longer.
I cannot carry things; my mouth is too small.

lines.zh: 有块石头沉下去，我看着。
lines.en: A stone sinks, and I watch it go.

lines.zh: 我试着顶一颗卵，它滑走了。
lines.en: I try to nudge an egg, and it slides away.

lines.zh: 落在池里的木棍，我推着玩。
lines.en: A stick falls in the pool, and I push it around.
I have no hands, only my mouth to touch with.
That basalt is heavier than I am.
I push a patch of ash toward the bank.

lines.zh: 有人掉了东西，沉进岩浆。
lines.en: Someone drops something, and it sinks into the lava.
I bite a reed, then let it go.
I am too lazy to fish things off the bottom.

lines.zh: 熔岩里捞出的小石子，真亮。
lines.en: A pebble fished from lava — how it shines.

lines.zh: 熔岩里这块小石子，是热的。
lines.en: This little stone from the lava is warm.
A bucket of lava is enough to hold me.
Found in the rock crack, so it's mine.
I'll hold it in my mouth and look later.
My little mouth can just hold it.
This is too hard to bite...
This pebble smells of sulfur.
This pebble is prettier than lava slag.
I grabbed it while swimming past.
A bug has landed on the water.
I fix on the thing that moves.
Who stepped on the edge of my pool?
I swing my head toward the noise.

lines.zh: 一条绯红蚊子的幼虫在扭。
lines.en: A crimson mosquito larva squirms nearby.

lines.zh: 我选中了最小的那个目标。
lines.en: I choose the smallest target.
Someone has put a hand into the water.

lines.zh: 它的影子比我的大很多。
lines.en: Its shadow is much bigger than mine.
I sink low and prepare to lunge.
That bug has not noticed me.
The target is half an inch ahead.
I lock on, and my tail goes taut.
You dare touch my lava shallows?

lines.zh: 为了窝里的小崽，我不退。
lines.en: For the little ones in the nest, I won't back down.
A bucket of lava is my home.

lines.zh: 跨座兽的幼体，也会顶人。
lines.en: Even a straddler's young knows how to butt.

lines.zh: 我还小，可我的角已经长了。
lines.en: I'm small, but my horn has grown in.

lines.zh: 玄武岩缝里，我盯上你了。
lines.en: From the basalt crack, I have you.

lines.zh: 别躲，我角尖已经对准你。
lines.en: Don't hide. My horn tip is already aimed at you.
Target: the grass in that one's mouth.
That grass. Mine.
No tender sprouts for me today.
I creep forward along the pool floor.
It is still moving, and I watch.
Nearer, nearer, still a little short.
I hold my breath, though I do not need to.

lines.zh: 它的影子晃，我的头不动。
lines.en: Its shadow wavers; my head stays still.

lines.zh: 它每摆一次尾，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Each flick of its tail brings me an inch closer.

lines.zh: 这个角度，一口就能咬到。
lines.en: From this angle, one bite will reach.
It turns, and I freeze at once.
The water is hot, and I am in no hurry.
I hide myself in the ash.
It is only a finger's width from the bank.
I watch its legs without blinking.
I can't spit out tadpoles yet.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，就钻进熔岩缝。
lines.en: One tail flick and I'm into the lava crack.
Huff... my little legs can't keep up.
Hold on, my tail can't keep up!
The lava is so thick I'm panting chasing you.
I swim slowly — the lava's thick.
Don't make me wag my tail this fast.
Go around the basalt pillar; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 跨座兽一甩，我就飞出去。
lines.en: One flick from a straddler sends me flying.
I swim slowly, but don't stop.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，它翻了过去。
lines.en: I ram it, and it flips over.

lines.zh: 我的嘴太小，只能咬一口。
lines.en: My mouth is small, so I only manage one bite.
This blow is not heavy, but it is hot.
I spring out of the water and hit it.
It pulls back, and I chase again.
My tail whips across its leg.
One bite only takes a little.
It steps on me, so I bite its foot.
I am weak, but I will not let go.
When it is done, I dive back into the lava.
I usually just swim. I don't butt people.
One butt with my little horn, just one.
Huff... I butted myself into a tumble.

lines.zh: 这一下是替窝里小崽的。
lines.en: This one is for the little ones in the nest.

lines.zh: 我被甩出去，也照样活着。
lines.en: Even thrown out, I keep living.
Don't dodge. Let my little horn touch you.
Step back three paces and I'll stop.
Small as I am, I still bite.

lines.zh: 用桶把我装走，才不会消失。
lines.en: Bucket me so I don't despawn.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也会狠顶一下。
lines.en: Small as I am, I can still butt hard.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆的泡里冒出来。
lines.en: I emerge from a bubble in the lava.
There is one more tadpole at the pool's edge.

lines.zh: 我的第一口呼吸是热的。
lines.en: My first breath is hot.
Ash falls on me, and I shake it off.
This shallow pool is enough for me to grow in.

lines.zh: 我从卵里钻出来，尾巴还软。
lines.en: I hatch from an egg with a soft tail.
Black stone and fire surround me.
I swim my first lap.

lines.zh: 大兽的影子从我头上过去。
lines.en: The shadow of a great beast passes over me.
The lava holds me up, and I float.
Is there shallow lava here?
Which way to the basalt deltas?
In the shallow lava, only my head shows.
I need to find some shallow lava.

lines.zh: 我刚从熔岩里孵出来，先找吃的。
lines.en: Just hatched from the lava, I look for food first.
Just opened my eyes in the lava. So bright.

lines.zh: 我叫跨座蝌蚪，请多关照。
lines.en: I'm Stradpole. Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 我从长辈嘴里被吐出来的。
lines.en: I was spat out of an elder's mouth.

lines.zh: 我是刚被吐出来的小蝌蚪。
lines.en: I'm the little tadpole just spat out.
Is the lava shallow enough here?
Fire feels like warm water to me.
Hot! The lava I'm soaking in is too hot!
I hit the ground and bounce once.

lines.zh: 被弹出来之前没人提醒我。
lines.en: No one warned me before I got launched.
I swim well in water; it cannot drown me.
This water is too deep. I can't swim.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我掀出池子。
lines.en: The blast throws me right out of the pool.
In a bucket, I still swim.
An arrow grazes my back, and it stings.

lines.zh: 泡在熔岩里还有东西扎我。
lines.en: Something stings me even soaking in lava.

lines.zh: 药水雾落下来，我发起抖。
lines.en: Potion mist falls on me, and I start to shiver.
A bucket of lava is home.
No bugs in the pool, and I am frantic with hunger.
I need food, and lava does not count.

lines.zh: 雷打在池边，我钻进水底。
lines.en: Thunder hits the bank, and I dive to the bottom.

lines.zh: 雷劈进熔岩，我尾巴僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the lava and my tail went stiff.

lines.zh: 虚空没有岩浆，我会冻僵。
lines.en: The void has no lava, and I would freeze.

lines.zh: 我想回三角洲吃口热的。
lines.en: I want to go back and eat something warm.
